title: REQ · ExecutionPanel shows a Reject button only for AWAITING_APPROVAL runs when onReject is given
summary: Optional onReject prop drives a Reject button gated on AWAITING_APPROVAL status.
description: Context: ExecutionPanel computes canApprove and canRetry from execution.status and optional callbacks. Desired behavior: add canReject = status === 'AWAITING_APPROVAL' && onReject !== undefined and render a Reject button in the execution-actions div that calls onReject(id). Expected result: Reject appears next to Approve only while awaiting approval. Why: admin needs to decline publication.
acceptance_criteria: Given AWAITING_APPROVAL and onReject, when rendered, then a Reject button is present next to Approve
Given the Reject click, when handled, then onReject is called with the execution id exactly once
Given FAILED or RUNNING status or no onReject, when rendered, then Reject is absent

preserve: execution-actions wrapper condition covers all three buttons

non_functional: Button is a native button type=button for accessibility
